title: epipactis atrorubens subvar. lutescens
intro: Epipactis atrorubens subvar. lutescens, commonly known as the yellow-tinged helleborine, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects that may aid in the treatment of various conditions such as digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis atrorubens subvar. lutescens include soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
